name: Doki Doki: Mengnan Jinrong Xueyuan
source:
In this story-driven romance simulation, you’ll play as Broken — a rich girl who struck oil in her own backyard and stumbled into sudden wealth, only to be sent to a prestigious Finance Academy after spectacular investment failures and a complete meltdown of her money sense.

Your mission?
Simple enough: learn how to invest, avoid bankruptcy, and maybe—just maybe—fall in love with one of the academy’s eccentric (and dangerously unstable) high-profile bachelors.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/weissgarden/doki-doki-school-of-muscular-finance]Kickstarter[/url]]
